_doc: Phone-level ground truth for the hook line 酒寒，我思念你, read off the isolated vocal stem (analysis/stems/vocals.wav) on Oct 8 by rev2_ls: 5 ms STFT, band energies (<1 kHz voiced, 5-12 kHz frication), autocorrelation pitch, spectral flux. Script and plots: render/out/rev2_ls/audio/onsets.py, spec_*.png. Times are song seconds; 'open' is the jaw/lip opening the phone needs on a 0..1 scale (0 = lips closed), 'shape' the lip shape. analysis/lyrics_timing.json (CTC) puts 思 at 82.125, which is the middle of its /s/: the hiss starts at 81.93 and the vowel at 82.21.

phones.shape: closing to a hum (level falls 12 dB, no energy above 5 kHz)
breath in through parted lips (unvoiced noise)
lips rounded forward, small (energy only below 1 kHz, pitch glides E4 to G4)
jaw closed, teeth together, lips drawn back narrow (hiss at 8-9 kHz, unvoiced)
narrow, tongue up (nasal hum, pitch falls to F4)
jaw drops: the widest opening of the phrase

events.what: 寒: jaw drops for the held 'ah'
思: jaw closes for the hiss
你: closes to the hum (after the shot's cut at 82.88)
